text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...This uneasy feeling just won't go 
away...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...It's like there's a fog in my head... 
It's frustrating... and my heart feels so 
heavy...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...I'll win here and clear away this 
gloom...!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
......I will live up to your 
expectations...!
